name: Dosilicon Co., Ltd.
summary: Dosilicon Co., Ltd. operates as a global provider of memory chip solutions, specializing in the design, manufacturing, and distribution of these components through a fabless business model. Its product portfolio encompasses a range of memory types, including NAND flash, NOR flash, and dynamic random-access memory (DRAM) chips, alongside various multi-chip packaging options. These memory solutions find extensive utility across diverse industries such as industrial automation, mobile technology, telecommunications, the Internet of Things (IoT), and security systems. Established in 2014, the firm maintains its primary operational base in Shanghai, China.
